name: RNA primer-template bound to GMP
notes: RNA primer-template complex with GMP at 1.80 Å. Ligand 5GP is guanosine-5'-monophosphate (MW 363, 1 P atom). Nucleotide-like ligand exercises baseStacking (guanine ring), phosphateElectrostatic (5'-phosphate near backbone), and ligandPhosphateWeight (1 P atom). Chain A used (4 identical chains in ASU). Ref: PDB 5DHB.
